# All about the new Seismic Activity event in Ash Heap / Nuka World on Tour

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_80_nukaknights-post-event-seismic-activity.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update 01/24/2023]** Rewards updated (New: 2-3 improved repair kits)

**Official subtitle: "A showdown with a terror of the wasteland on the Nuka Launcher roller coaster!"**

The Seismic Public Event is a new **Endgame Event**, as is Scorched Earth (Queen) or A Colossal Problem (Earle Wiliams), now taking place in the southwestern region of Appalachia in Ash Heap. Your final opponent there is the "Ultracite Titan", an oversized mole rat. As with the Queen and Earle, the event here must be triggered by a **nuclear missile impact**. In this case you have to cover the "**Abandoned Mineshaft 2**". The event then spawns just west of Lewisburg in “Nuka-Cola on Tour” (new location from December 6th, 2022).

![Event: Seismic Activity / Seismic Activity](/uploads/20221014080943-1.jpg)

All 3 of these nukazones cover the **abandoned mineshaft 2** and all triggered the event.

![Event: Seismic Activity / Seismic Activity (Abandoned Mine Shaft 2 Impact Zones)](/uploads/fallout76-20.11.2022-14-16-31.jpg)

## Process

After the event starts, bright yellow Ultracite crystals will shoot out of the ground in front of the Nuka Launcher roller coaster and a 10 minute timer will start. These ultracite crystals are the protection of the ultracite titanium. Only when the Ultracite crystals are destroyed does the Ultracite Titan take damage. However, the ultracite crystals can only be destroyed in close combat. So have a melee weapon ready when the event starts. If these crystals are not destroyed within 10 minutes, the event will fail.

![Ultracite Crystals: Must be destroyed in close combat. Only then does the Ultrazit Titan become vulnerable.](/uploads/20221014081222-1.jpg)

**Phase 1**

After the ultracite crystals have been destroyed, the game begins. A new timer of **3:30 minutes** starts, in which you have to **take approx. 25% life away** from the Ultracite Titan. The Ultracite Titan comes out of the ground and Mine Hewers and lots of Mole Rats spawn. **All these enemies and the Ultracite Titan itself ensure that you are permanently discovered.** As with the daily operations "Connector", where the enemies have higher perception. So you **can't sneak** and get **no "covert operations" damage bonus**. This means that the event is more difficult to play as a Command Build than as a Heavy Gunner. As a command build you are also more vulnerable to the attacks of the Ultracite Titan.

The Ultracite Titan launches its attacks every few seconds, releasing a wave of pressure and shocks. This means that as a command build you will quickly fall down somewhere if you have looked for a safe place from the mobs on the ground. The perk card “Blocker” helps somewhat against these attacks.

After the 25% life has been drained, the Ultracite Titan retreats back into the ground for the first time. Then you can first eliminate the mobs.

**Phase 2**

A few seconds later, the Ultracite Titan emerges from the ground again (with 75% health). A **timer of 3:30 minutes** starts again to deduct approximately **25% life** again. At this point, he is not vulnerable for now. You see a shield symbol instead of taking damage. And again the ultracite crystals shoot out of the ground, which must be destroyed in close combat. Only then is the Ultracite Titan vulnerable again. At less than 50% health he will dive again.

**Phase 3**

A few seconds later, the Ultracite Titan emerges from the ground again (with 50% health). A **timer of 3:30 minutes** starts again to get about **25% life** again
